newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NBM AMSTELLAND IN TALKS TO BUY HABO UNIT.
newsitem.headline: NBM AMSTELLAND IN TALKS TO BUY HABO UNIT.

text.p: Builder NBM Amstelland said on Wednesday it was in talks on the takeover of the civil engineering and road building company Habo GWW, a unit of Hague-based construction firm Habo NV.
"The expectation is justified that the talks will lead to the envisaged takeover (of Habo GWW by NBM Amstelland)," NBM-Amstelland said in a statement.

Habo GWW's activities include the building and maintenance of tram lines and overhead cabling, road construction and pipe and cable-laying, NBM Amstelland said. Annual turnover amounted to some 35 million guilders, it said.
The acquisition of Habo GWW would bolster NBM Amstelland's activities in rail and road construction in the province of South Holland, NBM said.
Habo GWW will be transferred to NBM Amstelland's infrastructure and environment division, which posted turnover of 570 million guilders in 1995.
NBM Amstelland said the takeover would not affect its full-year 1996 forecast of a rise in earnings per share of at least 15 percent.
